pp_data_collected_content: Depending on how you use our Services (website visit, mobile application use, Student Membership, etc.), the following data categories are collected:
pp_identity_data_content: Name, surname and e-mail address. We do not store your password; authentication runs through a separate provider. If you sign in with Google, Google passes your name, e-mail address and profile picture to us through our identity provider.
pp_academic_data_content: If you apply for student membership: university, department, areas of interest and the student status document you upload. The document is stored in a directory that is not directly reachable from the web and is viewed only to verify student status.
pp_visual_data_content: The coin photos you take or choose from your gallery when you use recognition. How they are processed - and why they are not stored - is set out under "Camera, Gallery and Your Photographs".
pp_technical_data_content: IP address, device make/model, operating system version and app version. The app does not use an advertising identifier.
pp_usage_data_content: Your collections, favourites, scan history and app preferences.
pp_purposes_content: Your collected personal data will be processed by our business units for the following purposes:
pp_purpose_service: Providing the Service: creating your membership, verifying your identity, photo-based coin recognition, collection/favourite/scan-history features.
pp_purpose_academic: Academic cooperation: assessing student membership applications and verifying student status.
pp_purpose_communication: Communication: account verification, password reset, service updates and your support requests.
pp_purpose_improvement: Improvement: measuring performance and fixing faults through aggregated, de-identified usage statistics.
pp_purpose_legal: Legal compliance: invoicing, tax and commercial record-keeping, requests from competent authorities.
pp_collection_method_title: Data Collection Method and Legal Basis
pp_collection_method_content: Your personal data is collected electronically, by automated or partly automated means, through the app interfaces, camera/gallery access and e-mail correspondence.
pp_legal_basis_content: This data is processed based on the following legal bases under GDPR:
pp_legal_basis_1: Performance of a contract (KVKK art. 5/2-c): membership and subscription, providing recognition, scan history and collection features.
pp_legal_basis_2: Legal obligation (art. 5/2-ç): invoicing, tax and commercial record-keeping, requests from competent authorities.
pp_legal_basis_3: Legitimate interest (art. 5/2-f): service security, abuse detection, enforcement of fair-use limits.
pp_legal_basis_4: Explicit consent (art. 5/1): should training of AI models ever apply, only with separately obtained explicit consent.
pp_data_transfer_content: We do not sell your personal data and do not share it for marketing without your explicit consent. To deliver the Service we share it, only to the extent necessary, with the recipients below. Some of these providers are located outside Türkiye; such transfers are made under KVKK art. 9.
pp_transfer_technical: Auth0 / Okta (membership and sign-in infrastructure - outside Türkiye), RevenueCat (syncing subscription status - outside Türkiye), Google Play Billing (in-app subscription purchases - outside Türkiye), our hosting providers and our e-mail delivery infrastructure.
pp_transfer_authorities: Competent public authorities: under legal requests, court orders and statutory obligations, limited to the scope of the request.
pp_camera_content: AnatolianCoins requests access to your device camera and photo library so that you can use coin recognition. The permission is used only for recognitions you start yourself and can be withdrawn at any time in your device settings. For the images you upload:
pp_camera_1: They are processed only to compute the visual similarity between your coin and the records in our catalogue and to show you the list of matches.
pp_camera_2: Not stored: the image is never written to disk; it is held in memory only and discarded as soon as processing finishes. We keep no archive of the photos you upload.
pp_security_content: We take appropriate technical and administrative measures to prevent unlawful processing of and access to personal data and to ensure its safekeeping: carrying all traffic over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), not storing passwords ourselves, role-based access, rate limiting and abuse detection, and never collecting payment card data. No internet service can guarantee absolute security; in the event of a breach we notify the Turkish Personal Data Protection Board and the affected individuals within the periods prescribed by law.
pp_retention_content: Your personal data is kept for as long as the purpose of processing requires and for the statutory retention periods prescribed by legislation:
pp_rights_content: Under GDPR Articles 15-22, you have the following rights as a data subject:
pp_right_1: Right of access: To obtain confirmation of whether your personal data is being processed and access to that data
pp_right_2: Right to rectification: To request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data
pp_right_3: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"): To request deletion of your personal data under certain conditions
pp_right_4: Right to restriction of processing: To request restriction of processing under certain conditions
pp_right_5: Right to data portability: To receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used format
pp_right_6: Right to object: To object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing
pp_right_7: Rights related to automated decision-making: Not to be subject to decisions based solely on automated processing
pp_right_8: Right to withdraw consent: To withdraw your consent at any time where processing is based on consent
pp_contact_content: For questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us. Full current text: numistr.org/en/privacy-policy-gdpr

pp_recognition_data_content: For each recognition request we record not the image itself but an irreversible digest of it (SHA-256), the time and duration of the request, the matches found with their confidence scores, your IP address and your device/browser string. These let us show your scan history, apply fair-use limits and investigate abuse.
pp_purpose_security: Security: enforcing fair-use limits, detecting account sharing and automated (bot) use.
pp_transfer_recognition: Recognition server: your photos are sent only to the Company's own recognition server; they are not sent to any third-party image-processing service.
pp_camera_3: All that remains is an irreversible digest (SHA-256) together with the recognition result; your photograph cannot be reconstructed from it.
pp_camera_4: AI training: the photos you upload are not currently used to train AI models; since they are not stored, such use is not technically possible. If this ever changes we will ask for your separate, explicit consent, and declining will not prevent you from using the Service.
pp_camera_5: The image travels over an encrypted connection (HTTPS) and is not sent to any third-party image-processing service.
pp_retention_1: Coin photographs: not retained - held in memory during processing, discarded immediately afterwards.
pp_retention_2: Membership, profile, subscription data and recognition records: for as long as your membership lasts; deleted when you close your account.
pp_retention_3: Student status document: deleted within 6 months of the application being concluded.
pp_retention_4: Payment and invoice records: 10 years, as required by tax and commercial law.
